Located in Alexandria, Egypt, the faculty supports teaching, research, and community outreach focused on sustainable agricultural development and food security. It brings together experts, researchers, and students to address real-world agricultural challenges in the region and beyond. The faculty emphasizes practical learning, innovation, and collaboration with industry, government, and local communities to improve agricultural practices and outcomes. Role Description The Agricultural Engineer position is a full-time, on-site role based at the Faculty of Agriculture – Alexandria University in Alexandria, Egypt. The role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing agricultural systems and practices, including irrigation, pest control, and farm planning. Day-to-day tasks include conducting field assessments, providing technical assistance to research teams and farmers, and supporting experimental trials and demonstration projects. The Agricultural Engineer will collaborate with faculty members and students, prepare technical reports and documentation, and contribute to training activities, workshops, and extension programs. The role also includes monitoring the performance of agricultural systems, recommending improvements, and ensuring compliance with relevant safety and environmental standards. Qualifications Strong foundation in Agricultural Engineering, with the ability to apply engineering principles to crop production, farm structures, and agricultural systems. Practical experience in Irrigation system design, operation, and optimization for different crops and soil conditions. Knowledge of Pest Control methods, including integrated pest management approaches and environmentally responsible practices. Ability to provide Technical Assistance to farmers, students, and research teams, including troubleshooting and field support. Skills in Planning agricultural projects, resource allocation, and scheduling field activities. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Agricultural Engineering or a closely related discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and propose technical solutions. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports and present findings. Capacity to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and engage with stakeholders from academic and community settings. Familiarity with regional agricultural practices in Egypt and an interest in sustainable agriculture is an advantage.
